description: This file manages in-app purchase subscriptions, including loading products, verifying receipts, setting premium status, and handling email verification dialogs for the Notesnook app.

methods.name: setPremiumStatus
methods.description: Sets the user's premium status based on subscription data and updates user store and database.

methods.name: loadProductsAndSubs
methods.description: Loads available subscription and product data from the app store.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Checks if the current user has an active non-free subscription plan.

methods.name: showVerifyEmailDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to verify the user's email and resend verification if needed.
